review_notes.note: 槍傷是嚴重的醫療緊急情況，可能導致快速失血、休克、重要器官損傷甚至死亡。此問卷不應取代或延遲尋求專業緊急醫療救護。應立即啟動創傷緊急應變流程。
應優先評估出血量、休克症狀（如意識改變、皮膚蒼白、冒冷汗）以及呼吸、心跳等生命體徵。胸部或腹部槍傷可能造成內出血或器官損傷，需要高度警覺。

rag_sources.title: Symptoms and Management of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) FAQ: What are the signs and symptoms of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)?, What are the signs and symptoms of severe or critical coron
rag_sources.excerpt: Fever or chills Cough Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing Fatigue Muscle or body aches Headache New loss of taste or smell Sore throat Congestion or runny nose Nausea or vomiting Diarrhea Other reported symptoms have included the following: Sputum production Malaise Respiratory distress What are the signs and symptoms of severe or critical coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)? Severe COVID-19 may be associated with dyspnea, hypoxia, or greater than 50% lung involvement on imaging. Critical COVID-19 may be associated with respiratory failure, shock, or multiorgan system dysfunction.
